messages.subject: Re: MULTILEVEL MEDIATION USING LAVAAN
parts:
Hi,

You may also try including country as a moderator variable (instead of conducting a multilevel model). The code would be as follows:

model = '
behaviors ~ subsafe
subsafe ~ age + gender
'
fit = sem(model, data=data, group="country")
summary(fit, fit.measures = T, standardized = T)

The part in the code "group='country'" is for cross-country comparison. If you have a path model, I think this is it. If you have a latent variable model, then you might also want to inspect for measurement invariance before you conduct cross-country comparisons.

Regards,
Jošt
